capabilities.text: Automatically send a nurse's note from Epic Cogito to CareTrack upon clicking 'Save and Close' with no extra user action
Display a toast notification in Epic Cogito to the day nurse confirming note sent, showing MRN, timestamp, and a green checkmark
Show a green 'Received' badge with note text, author, and timestamp in CareTrack's Shift Handover dashboard for successfully delivered notes
Show a grey 'Pending' badge with clock icon in CareTrack for notes expected but not yet received, updating to green within 30 seconds of receipt
Trigger a silent alert to the bridge monitoring dashboard if a note remains pending in CareTrack for more than 5 minutes
Retry sending a note once automatically if the initial send to CareTrack fails, without interrupting the nurse
Log failed note sends after two attempts in Azure Monitor and send a Teams alert to the IT incident channel
Discard notes after two failed send attempts without queuing, requiring manual resend via a backdoor endpoint by IT or care coordinators
Restrict access to audit logs containing note data to IT security team and compliance officer authenticated via Azure AD with elevated roles
Retain audit logs and bridge logs containing full note data for 90 days, automatically purging records thereafter with 48-hour advance notice to compliance
Send 48-hour purge warning notifications to compliance officer and IT security lead via Teams and email, allowing manual backup requests
Validate incoming CareTrack webhook calls using Azure AD OAuth 2.0 tokens with tenant endpoint verification and rotate client secrets every 90 days
Deduplicate note sends by discarding duplicate payloads with the same Epic FHIR event versionId received within 5 minutes, logging duplicates silently
Support a load of at least 50 note send requests per minute with an average response time of 2 seconds using Azure App Service with 4 vCPUs and 16 GB RAM
Allow night shift nurses to see a timestamp-synchronized green 'Received' badge within 30 seconds of note save in Epic, or a grey 'Pending' badge if delayed
Send Teams alerts to nurse supervisors (not nurses) if a note remains pending beyond 5 minutes, while night nurses proceed with manual checks
Ensure the note payload sent to CareTrack includes full note text, nurse author, MRN, encounter ID, and timestamp with no lookups required by CareTrack
Pass automated load tests simulating 50 note sends with at least 48 successful 'Received' badge displays within 30 seconds, triggering rollback on 3+ failures
